remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

spec2def(shcore.dll shcore.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_definitions(-DCONST_VTABLE)

# shcore.dll is all Rust (shcore-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/shcore-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/shcore-rust/src/shcore/main.rs)
# combase is not built here (see dll/win32/CMakeLists.txt): what main.c takes from it
# (CoTaskMem*, CoCreateInstance, ...) ole32 exports too. The DPI calls forward to
# shell32 (shcore.spec), which hosts them for the api sets and is graded against
# Windows; main.c's Wine versions of those are not exported.
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(shcore_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(shcore_shims PRIVATE crtheap wine wine_dll_canunload libole32 libadvapi32 libadvapi32_vista libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(shcore_shims)
add_dependencies(shcore_shims psdk)
add_cargo_module(shcore shcore-cargo shcore.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE shcore-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS shcore_shims psdk xdk)
